description: Tell the Leadgen founder what is missing or wrong: a missing field, firm or source (kind 'gap'), a wrong company record ('wrong_record', pass its cui), a bug, an idea. Free, never counted as a lookup. contact is optional (an address for a reply); nothing is mailed to it automatically. Registry records are corrected at the source (ONRC) and arrive with the next snapshot.
